verdict.rationale: Codex supports ChatGPT sign-in tied to Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise plans, and OpenAI's platform offers RBAC for org/project access control, suggesting some enterprise identity/compliance support. However, there's no direct evidence of SSO/SAML, SCIM, or cloud-IAM integration specifically for Codex, so enterprise-grade authentication is only weakly substantiated.
